versions.changelog:
- Product issue collection rules are now bundled within the skill package (offline), removing all runtime GitHub and OSS dependencies.
- Enhanced compatibility checks: requires aliyun CLI >= 3.3.3; skill verifies required CLI/plugin version and fails gracefully if missing or outdated.
- New per-product rule files under references/products/, streamlining and expanding supported ticket categories.
- Improved user privacy and security—no external rule downloads, no remote self-updates, and all network calls restricted to Alibaba Cloud Workorder OpenAPI.
- Updated docs and environment variable requirements to reflect local-only rule use and stricter execution flows.
- Removed skill-card.md and simplified state/env usage for easier deployment.

alibabacloud-support 0.0.1 – Initial release

- Enables management of Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) after-sales support tickets directly from conversation.
- Supports operations to list, create, view, reply to, close, and rate support tickets via the Workorder OpenAPI.
- Follows strict rules for information handling, redaction, ticket confirmation, and credential management.
- Provides fallback and self-degradation to ensure user experience even if rule sources or CLI are unavailable.
- Requires Python 3.9+ and optionally the aliyun CLI for API operations, with clear user consent before installing dependencies.
